name: EPIC 212389209
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 9.4 solar radii and 0.93 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 1,068 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.93 solar masses and 9.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,678 K at its surface.
